title: Benefits of Conversion Events and Conversion APIs for Publishers and Advertisers
summary: Explore the benefits of conversion APIs for advertisers and publishers, from better attribution to campaign optimization with LiveRamp and OpenX.
body_markdown:
Understanding which impressions drive business outcomes across channels is no longer a luxury in digital advertising – it’s a necessity. Advertisers expect every dollar to drive measurable results, and this is especially true as more companies brace for the[economic uncertainty](https://liveramp.com/blog/economic-uncertainty-strategic-clarity/) that lies ahead.


As advertisers demand greater accountability for every dollar spent, platforms and publishers are under pressure to provide deeper transparency and real-time campaign optimization. This is where robust[Conversion APIs](https://liveramp.com/our-platform/conversion-program) (CAPIs) provide a solution.


## Key takeaways


- Conversion APIs empower advertisers and publishers to connect real outcomes to ad spend.
- LiveRamp’s standardized, privacy-first workflows simplify activation across platforms.
- RampID enables higher match rates and persistent identity across the ecosystem.
- OpenX and LiveRamp’s partnership brings outcome-based inventory to programmatic advertising.


## What are CAPIs and why do publishers and advertisers need them?


Conversion APIs are server-to-server integrations that enable secure sharing of conversion data between advertisers and publishers. They're essential because they provide real-time campaign optimization, better attribution of ad spend to business outcomes, and secure measurement as cookies and device IDs become less reliable.


## What are conversion events?


Conversion events are the actions a business wants to measure after someone encounters an ad, such as making a purchase, submitting a lead form, or buying in a store. These events show whether media is contributing to outcomes that matter beyond clicks and impressions.


With LiveRamp’s Conversion API integrations, advertisers can share online and offline event data with supported platforms through standardized workflows. LiveRamp’s identity capabilities help connect eligible conversion records to ad exposures, giving advertisers clearer measurement and giving publishers and supply partners signals they can use to demonstrate the value of their inventory.


## Why should I choose LiveRamp for CAPI and conversion programs?


- **Secure, standardized data workflows:** LiveRamp connects across many platforms and publishers, eliminating the need for advertisers to send PII directly to multiple destinations for optimization and measurement. Our standardized data workflows and pre-built configurations for each CAPI program make it simple to activate conversion and event data across multiple CAPI programs.
- [Higher match rates](https://liveramp.com/blog/data-onboarding-101-match-rates/) : Built on the largest, most accurate identity graph available,[RampID](https://liveramp.com/blog/for-those-that-want-more-theres-rampid/) is the industry’s most interoperable and durable identifier for connecting data. It facilitates persistent identity resolution across the entire media and martech ecosystem and can increase match rates by up to 52% over[hashed emails](https://liveramp.com/blog/the-trouble-with-hashed-emails-hems/) .* Not only will RampID ensure more conversions are captured, but it will also preserve interoperability with other targeting and measurement efforts.
- [Actionable attribution](https://liveramp.com/blog/how-cross-channel-attribution-works/) : These integrations, powered by RampID, maximize the ability to accurately connect ad exposures to both online and offline conversion events at scale, unlocking real-time performance optimization and insights into the channels and creatives that truly drive results.


## What are the benefits of conversion events and CAPIs for SSPs and publishers?


- **Maximized revenue** : Provide high-value inventory and better quantify media impact to measure and optimize campaigns, which attracts incremental budgets from performance-focused advertisers.


- **Streamlined integrations** : With RampID embedded across platforms and publishers, LiveRamp’s connectivity provides the bridge between advertisers and SSPs and publishers, reducing technical lift and enabling faster, more efficient connections.
- **Privacy-conscious measurement** : As privacy standards evolve, server-to-server integrations, such as CAPIs, ensure continued access to critical conversion data, even as the utility of cookies and device IDs wanes. **‍**
- **Stronger identity matching:** RampID helps connect conversion events to ad exposures across participating platforms, giving SSPs and publishers a clearer view of how their inventory contributes to advertiser outcomes.


- **More actionable optimization:** Conversion signals can help supply partners identify inventory associated with purchases and other business outcomes, informing how they package and value that inventory for buyers.
- **Clearer proof of media impact:** Connecting online and offline conversion events to campaigns helps publishers and SSPs demonstrate value beyond impressions and clicks.


## OpenX and LiveRamp: Transforming supply strategy through CAPI


It’s no surprise that leading SSPs, such as OpenX, are investing in building more robust CAPIs, delivering measurable outcomes to their partners through the world’s largest data collaboration network.


This partnership unlocks a powerful new capability: Brands can now leverage first-party conversion data, such as in-store transactions or CRM events, securely and at scale within OpenX’s environment. As the trusted conduit, LiveRamp resolves transaction data to a RampID, facilitating compliance while maximizing utility. For the first time, this real-world outcome data enables ad supply teams to package, value, and surface inventory to buyers, all while prioritizing customer privacy.


"This isn’t just an integration – it’s a game-changer," said Brian Chisholm, Senior Vice President, Strategic Partnerships at OpenX. "We partnered with LiveRamp because we believe performance data, not proxies, should drive media investment. By embedding verified purchase signals directly into supply strategy, OpenX becomes one of the first SSPs to offer outcome-based inventory through LiveRamp’s trusted, privacy-first infrastructure. Together, we’re setting a new standard for accountable, data-driven advertising that delivers real business results.”


As one of the first SSPs to enable CAPI with LiveRamp, OpenX's expansion of this partnership is like giving an "easy button" to any brand or advertiser looking to optimize with verified purchase signals programmatically. By embedding conversion insights directly into supply strategy, OpenX is giving advertisers access to outcome-enriched inventory and paving the way for more efficient, measurable, and accountable media buying.


## Frequently asked questions


### How does LiveRamp's approach to CAPIs differ from other solutions?


LiveRamp offers three key advantages: standardized data workflows that eliminate the need to send PII to multiple destinations, higher match rates (up to 52% better than hashed emails) through RampID, and actionable attribution that connects ad exposures to both online and offline conversions at scale.


### What makes the OpenX and LiveRamp partnership significant for the industry?


OpenX is one of the first SSPs to enable CAPI with LiveRamp, allowing brands to securely leverage first-party conversion data (like in-store transactions) at scale within programmatic advertising. This partnership sets a new standard for outcome-based inventory and accountable, data-driven advertising that prioritizes privacy while delivering measurable business results.


Together, OpenX and LiveRamp aren’t just enhancing measurement – we’re empowering advertisers and publishers to achieve real business outcomes.


### **Why assign a monetary value to conversion events?**


Assigning a value helps advertisers measure the business impact of an action, not just how often it happens. A purchase can use its transaction amount; a lead can use an estimated value based on its likelihood of becoming a customer. When supported by the destination platform, sharing that value through a Conversion API can help advertisers evaluate return on ad spend and optimize toward higher-value outcomes.


### **How can a Conversion API help lower cost per conversion?**


A Conversion API sends conversion events directly to supported ad platforms, giving them more complete signals for measurement and campaign optimization. LiveRamp helps connect those events to ad exposures and streamline delivery across platforms. Better signals can help advertisers identify what is working and adjust campaigns, though a lower cost per conversion depends on factors such as event quality, campaign setup, and the platform’s optimization capabilities.
